title: sst.dev.yaml
description: What sst pulumi dev runs of a Pulumi program: the functions to run on this machine, and the dev commands. It's next to Pulumi.yaml.

functions.description: Functions to run on this machine in sst pulumi dev, by their name in the program. A name can be a pattern, where * is any text and ? one character: a function takes its own name if the file has it, or else the first pattern that matches. What a pattern matches but sst pulumi dev can't run stays in the cloud.

oneOf.description: The source handler, from the folder of Pulumi.yaml, like functions/api.handler. {name} is the function's name.

handler.description: The source handler, from the folder of Pulumi.yaml, like functions/api.handler. {name} is the function's name.

runtime.description: What builds and runs it. Defaults to the function's own: Node.js and Python. A function on provided.al2023 needs one: go.

streaming.description: Whether it streams its response, as one behind a function URL with invokeMode RESPONSE_STREAM does.

commands.description: Commands sst pulumi dev runs beside it, each in a pane of its own, by name. They leave nothing in the stack.

directory.description: The folder it runs in, from the folder of Pulumi.yaml.

autostart.description: Whether it starts with sst pulumi dev, or waits to be started.

title.description: The title of its pane. Defaults to its name.

environment.description: Environment variables. ${name} is the stack's output of that name.

role.description: A role it runs as: a role of the program, by name, which sst pulumi dev lets your account take, or a role's ARN. It gets that role's credentials, and none of yours.
